pages.text: Using the lingering spirit left behind by a Bellringer after its death, you have managed to reproduce a 'Bellringer' that obeys your commands—a trivial task for one as adept in necromancy as yourself. Regrettably, while this spirit is considerably stronger than ordinary ghosts, that's about the extent of it.

But as you well know, for spectral undead creatures of this nature, the spiritual essence of their own kind serves as a most nourishing tonic. And for a Bellringer, whose spirit is already quite resilient, it can even absorb multiple doses of ectoplasm from its kin—this would make them far more powerful.
